semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Nagase (Taiwan) Co., Ltd. engages in the trade of chemical raw materials and electronic materials, which are relevant to the semiconductor industry.
summary: Nagase (Taiwan) Co., Ltd. is involved in the import and export of chemical raw materials and electronic materials, which are essential for semiconductor manufacturing. The company aims to enhance collaboration with the Nagase Group to develop innovative solutions that meet customer needs in the semiconductor space.
capabilities: Chemical raw materials for semiconductor applications
Adhesives and epoxies for assembly and packaging

regional_presence.Taiwan: The company operates as a subsidiary of the Nagase Group in Taiwan, focusing on international trade and consulting.
